_note: The African bullfrog's life (the river tie-up part B, 2026-11-23; all numbers my picks, fun first, inspired by the real frog). Sizes are shares of a male's usual size (0.8 blocks): males 0.9 to 1.1, females the user's 0.65 blocks, 0.9 to 1.1 of that (0.73 to 0.89). Young are froglets: a tadpole climbs out at 0.32 of its grown size and grows up in 3 days (the tadpole's own 3 days come before, TadpoleEntity). They breed in the rains, while it rains: males call, and a ready female within 16 blocks comes to a calling male; he climbs onto her back and clasps her (courtship ticks count every other game tick, so 160 is 16 seconds) while she carries him to the shallows, where she lays a floating mat of 8 to 12 eggs at the surface; they hatch in a day into a tadpole school, and the father guards the eggs and then his school for 3 days. A female breeds once every 4 days. Breeds only while fewer than 4 bullfrogs live within 48 blocks (the user's cap of 4) and the frog group is under its cap; a tadpole becomes a froglet by the same rule.
